# netcup_dns_record (Resource)

Manages a single DNS record for a domain hosted at netcup.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_dns_record" "www" {
  zone        = "example.com"
  hostname    = "www"
  type        = "CNAME"
  destination = "example.com"
}

resource "netcup_dns_record" "mx" {
  zone        = "example.com"
  hostname    = "@"
  type        = "MX"
  destination = "mail.example.com"
  priority    = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Target/destination of the record.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the record. Use '@' for the zone apex.
- `type` (String) DNS record type such as A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, etc.
- `zone` (String) Domain name of the DNS zone (e.g. example.com).

### Optional

- `priority` (Number) Record priority, required for MX records.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID assigned to the record by the netcup API.
